speaking.de_tom_tat: Reading tốc độ — Part 1 và Part 3 về đọc và thông tin.

cau_tra_loi.mau: Less than I'd like. Mostly work-related material and news during the week, then a book at weekends if I have the time.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: "Less than I'd like" — trả lời trung thực có sắc thái, hay hơn "yes, a lot".

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Part 1 — Do you prefer paper books or e-books?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Paper, for anything I want to remember. I retain far more from a printed page, oddly enough. E-books are more practical when travelling, though.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Nêu tiêu chí phân biệt ("anything I want to remember") thay vì chọn chung chung.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Part 3 — Are people reading less than they used to?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Reading less deeply, I'd say, rather than reading less overall. We probably read more words per day than any previous generation — but mostly in fragments. Sustained attention on a long argument is what's declining.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Tinh chỉnh chính câu hỏi ("less deeply rather than less overall") — kỹ thuật band cao.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Part 3 — Should schools still teach reading of long texts?
cau_tra_loi.mau: More than ever, I'd argue. If nobody can follow a complex argument for twenty pages, public debate suffers — you end up with policy decided by headlines. It's a skill that has to be trained deliberately, because nothing in daily life requires it any more.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Nêu hệ quả xã hội cụ thể ("policy decided by headlines") — lập luận có chiều sâu.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Trả lời có tiêu chí phân biệt và tinh chỉnh câu hỏi.
retain · in fragments · sustained attention · deliberately.
Reading less deeply rather than reading less overall · If nobody can follow… public debate suffers · It's a skill that has to be trained.

meo_noi: Tinh chỉnh câu hỏi ("X rather than Y") là cách nhanh nhất thể hiện tư duy sắc — nhưng phải đúng.
Nêu hệ quả cụ thể ("policy decided by headlines") thay vì nói chung "nó không tốt".
"More than ever, I'd argue" — mở đầu dứt khoát, thu hút chú ý giám khảo.
